route_terms.purchased_research: Commission a bounded capability question with paid evidence delivery and uncertain outcome; repeat necessary local acceptance work.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Buy delivered equipment or finite provider operations; continued service depends on reachable logistics and provider capacity.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Inspect delivered hardware with finite analysis and trial expense; do not infer hidden material history or environmental qualification from appearance.

scope_boundary: A distinct proposed surface operation, not an assertion that this technology is currently deployed or that its full economic feasibility has been demonstrated. Existing broad space, power and habitat discoveries retain their identities.
implementation_status: Design only. Physical site inventories, equipment duty, failure state, acquisition costs, rival decisions and full-history progression remain to be implemented.
